recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future Pharmacy changes to free-text medication instructions should update shared Dosage/DosageDetails datatype guidance rather than duplicating resource-local prose for retired DSTU1 structures.
issue_request: FHIR-5925 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Pharmacy change request for MedicationDispense, MedicationPrescription, and MedicationStatement asking to add "free text SIG" to the description of .dosage.text.
initial_application: Legacy commit 1cb9689e725c06210bbeaa920648410591a426d4 explicitly named change request 5925 and updated medication dosage.text/SIG wording before the medication dosage model was later refactored into shared datatypes.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is now MedicationRequest. source/fhir.ini keeps Dosage, DosageDetails, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement active. Later already-published reconciliation work for FHIR-39319 clarified active Dosage.text as a complete free-text dosage/SIG representation, and FHIR-54014 introduced the required DosageDetails.renderedInstruction full-intent model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/datatypes/dosage.xml already says Dosage.text is a free text representation of the dosage commonly called the SIG, and current medication resources use the shared DosageDetails/Dosage model rather than retired resource-local dosage.text children.
